comment: Deterministic, permanent skip: this test requires an RSA client key to sign an RS256 client assertion, and this AS's registered clients only ever use ES256 (see oidf-config/message-signing.config.json and cmd/conformance-as's algorithm policy - no RSA support by design). The suite's own skip message confirms this does not prevent certification.

Same root cause as ensure-signed-client-assertion-with-RS256-fails, applied to request object signing instead of client assertion signing: this test requires an RSA client key to sign an RS256 request object, and this AS's registered clients only ever use ES256. Only reachable under a profile that actually sends signed request objects (message-signing), which is why it doesn't appear in expected-skips-baseline.json.
